person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: the interconversion of chemical structures between file formats, and the 111 formats Open Babel implements
span.quote: With the release of Open Babel 2.3, Open Babel supports 111 chemical file formats in total. It can read 82 formats and write 85 formats.

span.label: how a single toolkit can read and write the many incompatible representations of molecular data
span.quote: A frequent problem in computational modeling is the interconversion of chemical structures between different formats.

span.label: Open Babel itself, described for the first time, with a round-trip validation taking the error rate from 8% to 0.01%
span.quote: At the time of starting this work (March 2009), the error rate found was 1424 (8%); by Oct 2009, combined work on stereochemistry, kekulization and canonicalization had reduced this to 190 (~1%), and continued improvements have reduced the number of errors down to two (shown in Figure 4) for Open Babel 2.3.1 (~0.01%).

span.label: method
span.quote: With the release of Open Babel 2.3, Open Babel supports 111 chemical file formats in total. It can read 82 formats and write 85 formats.

span.label: the proliferation of incompatible chemical file formats, which a standard failed to resolve
span.quote: While attempts have been made to provide a standard format for storing chemical data, including most notably the development of Chemical Markup Language (CML) [2-6], an XML dialect, such formats have not yet achieved widespread use.

span.label: an open-source C++ library with formats as plugins, validated by a round-trip over 18,084 structures and a nightly test suite
span.term: an open-source C++ library with formats as plugins, validated by a round-trip over 18,084 structures and a nightly test suite
span.quote: Starting with a dataset of 18,084 3D structures from PubChem3D as an SDF file, we compared the result of (a) conversion to SMILES, followed by conversion of that to Canonical SMILES to (b) conversion directly to Canonical SMILES.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: BOND CONNECTIVITY FROM GEOMETRY ALONE: atoms closer than the sum of their covalent radii plus 0.45 angstrom are bonded, which is what lets formats that store no bonding at all be read as molecules
span.quote: Bond connectivity is determined by the frequently used algorithm of detecting atoms closer than the sum of their covalent radii, with a slight tolerance (0.45 Å) to allow for longer than typical bonds.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: AROMATICITY IS WITHHELD UNLESS A KEKULE PATTERN EXISTS: the ring is only called aromatic when a well-defined valence-bond assignment can be found, so the label is earned by a construction rather than asserted from ring membership
span.quote: Aromaticity is established only if a well-defined valence bond Kekulé pattern can be determined.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: AN EXPONENTIAL SEARCH WITH A DELIBERATE GIVE-UP: kekulisation terminates at 30 levels of recursion or 15 seconds, so a large fused ring system returns no answer rather than hanging
span.quote: Since this process is exponential in complexity, the algorithm will terminate if more than 30 levels of recursion or 15 seconds are exceeded (which may occur in the case of large fused ring systems such as carbon nanotubes).

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: SUBSTRUCTURE SEARCH BY HASHED BIT-STRING: every linear and ring substructure of length 1 to 7 is mapped onto 1024 bits, so a query's bits must all be set in any target that contains it
span.quote: This fingerprint, referred to as FP2 in Open Babel, identifies all linear and ring substructures in the molecule of lengths 1 to 7 (excluding the 1-atom substructures C and N) and maps them onto a bit-string of length 1024 using a hash function.

span.label: TWO round-trip failures remain at 0.01%, and the paper names both: a kekulisation error in a polycyclic aromatic with heteroatoms, and a bridgehead-carbon stereochemistry case
span.quote: At the time of starting this work (March 2009), the error rate found was 1424 (8%); by Oct 2009, combined work on stereochemistry, kekulization and canonicalization had reduced this to 190 (~1%), and continued improvements have reduced the number of errors down to two (shown in Figure 4) for Open Babel 2.3.1 (~0.01%).

span.label: Molecules outside the pharmaceutical mainstream - radicals, organometallics, inorganics, coordinate and 3-center 2-electron bonds - are stated to be poorly supported, and not only by this toolkit
span.quote: Typically toolkits focus on the types of molecules of principal importance to the pharmaceutical industry, namely stable organic molecules comprising wholly of 2-center 2-electron covalent bonds. Molecules outside this set - such as radicals, organometallic and inorganic molecules, molecules with coordinate bonds or 3-center 2-electron bonds - are poorly supported in general.

span.label: Kekulisation is exponential and is CUT OFF at 30 levels of recursion or 15 seconds, so large fused ring systems are a known non-answer
span.quote: Since this process is exponential in complexity, the algorithm will terminate if more than 30 levels of recursion or 15 seconds are exceeded (which may occur in the case of large fused ring systems such as carbon nanotubes).

span.label: The standard that was meant to remove the problem did not take: CML exists and is not widely used, which is the premise the whole toolkit rests on
span.quote: While attempts have been made to provide a standard format for storing chemical data, including most notably the development of Chemical Markup Language (CML) [2-6], an XML dialect, such formats have not yet achieved widespread use.

span.label: a round-trip over 18,084 PubChem3D structures: SDF to SMILES to canonical SMILES, compared against SDF straight to canonical SMILES
span.note: eliminates: errors anywhere in reading SDF, reading and writing SMILES, and canonicalisation - by making two routes to the same answer disagree
span.quote: Starting with a dataset of 18,084 3D structures from PubChem3D as an SDF file, we compared the result of (a) conversion to SMILES, followed by conversion of that to Canonical SMILES to (b) conversion directly to Canonical SMILES.

span.label: a nightly test suite of 60 programs, each with tens to hundreds of tests
span.quote: Open Babel includes an extensive test suite comprising 60 different test programs each with tens to hundreds of tests.

span.quote: With the release of Open Babel 2.3, Open Babel supports 111 chemical file formats in total. It can read 82 formats and write 85 formats.

span.label: Tanimoto coefficient
span.quote: The fingerprints for two molecules can also be used to calculate structural similarity using the Tanimoto coefficient, the number of bits in common divided by the union of the bits set.

span.label: OELib
span.quote: Open Babel has its origin in a version of OELib released as open-source software by OpenEye Scientific under the GPL (GNU Public License). In 2001, OpenEye decided to rewrite OELib in-house as the proprietary OEChem library, so the existing code from OELib was spun out into the new Open Babel project.

span.label: file formats
span.quote: With the release of Open Babel 2.3, Open Babel supports 111 chemical file formats in total. It can read 82 formats and write 85 formats.

span.label: canonical representation - A CHOICE, NOT A FACT ABOUT THE MOLECULE: the same structure has N! orderings that encode exactly the same information, and canonicalisation picks one so it can be used as a database key
span.quote: While each of the orderings encodes exactly the same information, it can be useful to define a canonical numbering of the atoms of a molecule and use this to derive a canonical representation of a molecule for a particular file format.

span.label: failure - IN THIS PAPER A ROUND-TRIP DISAGREEMENT, not a wrong answer: two routes to the same canonical SMILES are compared against each other, and the second of the two residual failures is a case where BOTH strings are correct and the algorithm merely failed to choose
span.quote: The second failure involves confusion over the canonical stereochemistry at a bridgehead carbon
